summary: Basic Fit is european fitness center chain, founded in 1984. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about acquisitions; 5 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: Europe's biggest budget gym chain, headquartered in Hoofddorp; IND recognised sponsor with English-friendly data and tech roles that mostly show pay.

culture.text: Value-for-money gym chain with more than 4.7 million members across 1,650+ clubs in 6 countries.
Stresses collaboration and impact, and says you can have fun at work.
All 4 open jobs are at the Hoofddorp head office, mostly data and AI, and 3 of 4 show pay.

open.text: Basic Fit International B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
All 4 open jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

growth.text: Wants to raise €180 million to refinance its debt.

worth_knowing.text: Launched an AI personal trainer for members.
